blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Counsel for the prosecution Benjamin Tolosa Jr. has revealed that the Senate Impeachment Court admonished him. This happened after he gave his explanation on why he should not be cited for violation of the sub judice rule over his comments during media interviews. Tolosa made the disclosure in a press briefing on Tuesday
